name: popsicle
headline: InPactAI - AI-Powered Creator Collaboration
short_description: Inpact is an open-source AI-powered platform designed to connect content creators, brands, and agencies through data-driven insights. By leveraging Generative AI (GenAI), audience analytics, and engagement metrics, Inpact ensures highly relevant sponsorship opportunities for creators while maximizing ROI for brands investing in influencer marketing
author: AOSSIE-Org

sections.overview:
InPactAI is an open-source platform that uses generative AI and audience analytics to match content creators with relevant brand sponsorships and optimize deal terms. The platform connects creators, brands, and agencies by analyzing audience demographics, engagement metrics, and content style to recommend ideal partnerships. It includes features for AI-based pricing recommendations, contract generation, collaboration discovery between creators, and ROI tracking. Creators benefit from relevant sponsorship opportunities while brands maximize influencer marketing ROI through data-driven matching and performance analytics.
Connect creators with brand sponsorships based on audience fit and engagement metrics
Generate AI-optimized pricing recommendations for sponsorship deals
Auto-generate and negotiate sponsorship contracts with AI-powered terms
Find complementary creators for joint collaboration campaigns
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/InPactAI`
sections.usage:
```
Use InPactAI to identify the top 3 micro-influencers (10K-100K followers) in [INDUSTRY/NICHE] who have the highest predicted engagement rate for a campaign targeting [DEMOGRAPHIC]. For each influencer, provide: (1) their follower count, (2) average engagement rate, (3) predicted cost per post, and (4) 2-3 suggested content angles aligned with their audience. Prioritize creators whose past sponsored posts align with [BRAND_VALUES].
```
Copy

```
Here are the top 3 micro-influencers for your vegan skincare campaign targeting millennial women (ages 25-34) in the U.S., based on InPactAI’s predictive analytics and historical performance data:

1. **@EcoGlowByLena** (68K followers)
   - **Avg. Engagement Rate:** 12.7% (5.2x industry benchmark)
   - **Predicted Cost per Post:** $850
   - **Content Angles:**
     - "A 5-Day Vegan Skincare Reset" (educational series on ingredient benefits)
     - "Before & After: My 30-Day Vegan Routine" (authentic transformation)
   - **Alignment:** 87% of past sponsored posts featured cruelty-free or organic brands.

2. **@GreenBeautyDiaries** (42K followers)
   - **Avg. Engagement Rate:** 11.9%
   - **Predicted Cost per Post:** $620
   - **Content Angles:**
     - "Debunking Skincare Myths with Science" (myth-busting carousel)
     - "Affordable Vegan Dupes for Luxury Products" (budget-friendly tips)
   - **Alignment:** 92% of sponsored content focuses on transparency and sustainability.

3. **@VeganGlowUp** (91K followers)
   - **Avg. Engagement Rate:** 10.5%
   - **Predicted Cost per Post:** $1,100
   - **Content Angles:**
     - "Glow-Up Challenge: 7 Days to Brighter Skin" (interactive challenge)
     - "Vegan Skincare for Sensitive Skin" (niche expertise)
   - **Alignment:** 78% of past partnerships included clean beauty brands.

**Why These Creators?** InPactAI’s model predicts these influencers will drive a **34% higher conversion rate** than the industry average for vegan skincare, with an estimated **$12,000 in incremental revenue** per $1,000 spent. Their audiences skew 89% female, 25-34, with a strong interest in ethical consumerism. For the campaign, consider allocating 60% of the budget to @EcoGlowByLena and @GreenBeautyDiaries due to their higher engagement and cost efficiency.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
